estfc.config.title: Ecliptic Seasons TFC Compat Configuration
estfc.config.enableTFCCompat.tooltip:
When enabled, solar terms and weather are derived from TFC's calendar and climate system.
When disabled, falls back to vanilla Ecliptic Seasons behavior.
estfc.config.snowAppearanceTemp.tooltip:
Temperature at which snow starts to appear (°C).
Above this temperature → no snow (depth=0).
Default: 0.0
estfc.config.snowFullCoverageTemp.toolti:
Temperature at which snow reaches 100% coverage (depth=100).
Below this temperature → full snow.
Default: -4.0
estfc.config.snowSnowfallFullTemp.toolti:
Temperature for 100% snow coverage during active snowfall (°C).
Warmer than normal full temp → boosted snow probability while precipitating.
After snowfall stops, curve falls back and excess snow melts naturally via tickChunk.
Default: -2.0
estfc.config.snowMeltTemp.tooltip:
Temperature above which snow starts to melt (°C).
Should match the snow appearance temperature.
Default: 0.0
estfc.config.dhUnloadedTempOffset.toolti:
Temperature fine-tuning offset for DH/Voxy distant view (°C).
Primary correction is automatic via Z→avgSeaLevelTemp cache (sampled and interpolated/gradient-extrapolated from loaded chunks).
Elevation lapse rate (0.16225°C/block) and N/S hemisphere handled by TFC.
This offset is for fine-tuning: positive=warmer distant (less snow), negative=colder distant (more snow).
Default: 0.0
estfc.config.unloadedTempSampleRange.too:
Sampling radius of TfcUnloadedTempEstimator along Z axis (blocks).
Larger = more accurate distant temperature, negligible performance impact (cached positions are skipped).
Default: 10240
estfc.config.elevationLapseRate.tooltip:
Elevation lapse rate (°C per 10 blocks).
TFC precise value is -1.6225°C/10m (0.16225°C/block).
Handled internally by TFC adjustTemperatureByElevation. Kept for future use.
Default: -1.6225
estfc.config.snowAccumulationSpeedMultip:
Snow accumulation speed multiplier.
Affects biome snow depth growth per tick.
Default: 1.0
estfc.config.snowMeltSpeedMultiplier.too:
Snow melt speed multiplier.
Affects biome snow depth reduction per tick.
Default: 1.0
estfc.config.snowTextureSimpleMode.toolt:
When enabled, uses estfc:block/snow texture for all TFC blocks.
When disabled, differentiates textures by block type.
Default: false
estfc.config.snowTextureReplaceMode.tool:
When enabled, ES replaces the original block model with our snow model.
When disabled, uses ES overlay mode (may cause double textures).
Default: true
estfc.config.snowTextureDefaultPath.tool:
Default snow texture path in ResourceLocation format (no namespace prefix).
Default: block/snow
estfc.config.tfcSnowBlockPrefixes.toolti:
Comma-separated list of TFC block path prefixes.
Blocks matching these prefixes get snow model replacement.
A trailing / matches all blocks whose path starts with that prefix.
estfc.config.tfcSimpleSnowBlocks.tooltip:
Comma-separated list of blocks using simple snow mode.
These blocks use uniform snow.png on all faces.
Supports full IDs (tfc:groundcover/bone) and path prefixes (rock/loose/).
